description: Resolve a Farcaster cast — identified by username/fid + short hash, or by its full 40-hex hash — and return the URL that opens it in a target Farcaster client app (or all supported apps). Also returns the author's signed-contract status; URLs are returned regardless of signed state. Link-only clients are gated: they answer client_ineligible when the resolved cast carries no external link.

client.description: Target Farcaster client app, or "all" to return every supported client's URL.

longhash.description: Full cast hash — 40 hex characters, with or without the 0x prefix. Identifies the cast on its own; the most reliable form for fresh casts.

shorthash.description: Abbreviated cast hash as it appears in share URLs — 4-39 hex characters, 0x prefix optional. Requires username or fid alongside it.

name: get_cast_link
title: Get cast link
